scripts.dev: npm run build:web && wrangler d1 migrations apply anki-leaderboard --local && wrangler dev --var INVITE_HMAC_KEY:local-dev-key-not-for-production-use
scripts.e2e:server: rm -rf .wrangler/e2e && npm run build:web && wrangler d1 migrations apply anki-leaderboard --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e && wrangler dev --port ${E2E_PORT:-8787} --persist-to .wrangler/e2e --var INVITE_HMAC_KEY:e2e-only-key-not-for-production-use
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:web && npm run test:addon
scripts.deploy: npm run build:web && npm run deploy:config && wrangler d1 migrations apply anki-leaderboard --remote -c wrangler.deploy.jsonc && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.deploy.jsonc
